stories.headline: Meta delays flagship AI model 'Avocado' to May after it underperforms vs Gemini and Anthropic

key_facts.fact: Meta postponed the release of its AI model codenamed 'Avocado' from March to at least May 2026, after internal tests showed it lagging behind newer models from Google and Anthropic.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta has postponed the release of its artificial intelligence model 'Avocado' to at least May, from this month, the New York Times reported on Thursday, citing sources.

key_facts.fact: Avocado's performance falls between Google's Gemini 2.5 and the latest Gemini 3.0 — it outperformed earlier Gemini versions and Meta's own prior models, but did not match the capabilities of the latest Gemini release or Anthropic's systems.
key_facts.excerpt: Internal tests showed 'Avocado' is lagging behind newer models from companies such as Alphabet Inc.'s Google and Anthropic. While Avocado performed better than Meta's earlier AI systems and even surpassed an earlier version of Google's Gemini model, it reportedly did not match the capabilities of the latest Gemini release.

key_facts.fact: Meta executives discussed the possibility of temporarily licensing technology from Google's Gemini models to support certain AI products while Avocado catches up, though no final decision was made.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta executives discussed the possibility of temporarily licensing technology from Google's Gemini models to support certain AI products, though no final decision was made.

key_facts.fact: The delay comes despite Meta projecting spending up to $135 billion on AI infrastructure in 2026, nearly double the approximately $72 billion spent in 2025. Meta shares fell 2.55% on the news.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta projected spending up to $135 billion on AI infrastructure and capabilities in 2026, nearly double the approximately $72 billion spent in 2025. Meta shares fell 2.55% to $638.18.

key_facts.fact: Internally, Meta's focus is shifting toward a larger next-generation model codenamed 'Watermelon,' while a separate model called 'Mango' focuses on image and video generation.
key_facts.excerpt: Related Projects: Mango: A model focused on image and video generation. Watermelon: A future system in development.

stories.headline: NVIDIA AI-Q agent takes first place on both DeepResearch Bench I and II with open stack

key_facts.fact: NVIDIA's AI-Q deep research agent achieved first place on both DeepResearch Bench (55.95) and DeepResearch Bench II (54.50), the two primary benchmarks for evaluating deep research agents, using a single configurable open stack.
key_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA AI-Q deep research agent recently achieved first place on both DeepResearch Bench(55.95) and DeepResearch Bench II(54.50), the two primary benchmarks for evaluating deep research agents.

key_facts.fact: AI-Q uses a three-component multi-agent architecture — orchestrator, planner, and researcher — with the researcher dispatching parallel specialists including Evidence Gatherer, Mechanism Explorer, Comparator, Critic, and Horizon Scanner.
key_facts.excerpt: Three-component system: Orchestrator coordinates the research loop, Planner maps information landscape and designs evidence-grounded research plans, Researcher dispatches parallel specialists (Evidence Gatherer, Mechanism Explorer, Comparator, Critic, Horizon Scanner).

key_facts.fact: The system runs on a fine-tuned NVIDIA Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B model, trained on 67,000 supervised fine-tuning trajectories that included real web search results, requiring approximately 25 hours on 16x8 NVIDIA H100 GPUs.
key_facts.excerpt: Fine-tuned NVIDIA Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B. 67,000 SFT trajectories filtered from ~80k generated. Training: 1 epoch, 5,615 steps, ~25 hours on 16×8 NVIDIA H100 GPUs.

key_facts.fact: Winning both benchmarks is significant because they test complementary skills: DeepResearch Bench evaluates polished synthesis and narrative quality, while Bench II uses 70+ fine-grained binary rubrics verifying factual correctness and analytical rigor.
key_facts.excerpt: DeepResearch Bench tests polished, well-structured narratives and strong synthesis. DeepResearch Bench II uses 70+ fine-grained binary rubrics to verify granular factual correctness and analytical rigor.

key_facts.fact: The entire stack is open and config-driven — all components (LLMs, tools, graphs) are swappable via YAML, built on NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit and LangChain DeepAgents.
key_facts.excerpt: One configurable stack leading on both shows that developer accessible models and tooling can power state-of-the-art agentic research. All components (LLMs, tools, graphs) are swappable via YAML.

sources.title: How NVIDIA AI-Q Reached #1 on DeepResearch Bench I and II

stories.headline: Axiom raises $200M at $1.6B valuation to build formally verified AI-generated code

key_facts.fact: Axiom Quant raised a $200 million Series A led by Menlo Ventures, reaching a $1.6 billion valuation, following a $64 million seed round in October 2025. The company aims to eliminate AI hallucinations through formal mathematical verification.
key_facts.excerpt: The Series A round, which brings Axiom's valuation to $1.6 billion, was led by Menlo Ventures and represents a bet on a new paradigm it calls 'verified AI' that aims to eliminate the risk of 'hallucinations' once and for all.

key_facts.fact: Axiom trains AI systems to generate formally verified code outputs using Lean, a programming language for mathematical proofs, with deterministic proof verifiers ensuring each reasoning step is machine-checkable and logically guaranteed.
key_facts.excerpt: The technology uses 'deterministic proof verifiers' to ensure each step of reasoning is 'machine-checkable' and logically guaranteed. This provides mathematical certainty that AI-generated functions return correct answers.

key_facts.fact: The company creates a 'verified data flywheel' where proof-checked data feeds back into training loops, enabling recursive self-improvement without model collapse — each generation's outputs are formally verified before becoming the next generation's training data.
key_facts.excerpt: Axiom creates a 'verified data flywheel' of proof-checked data fed back into training loops, enabling recursive self-improvement without model collapse.

key_facts.fact: Axiom achieved a perfect score on the Putnam Competition (the world's hardest undergraduate math exam) in December 2025 and proved a 20-year-old number theory conjecture involving differential geometry.
key_facts.excerpt: December 2025: Perfect score on Putnam Competition (world's hardest undergraduate math exam). Proved a 20-year-old number theory conjecture involving differential geometry.

key_facts.fact: CEO Carina Hong is a 25-year-old Stanford Ph.D. student and MIT graduate. Co-founder Ken Ono is a Guggenheim/Packard/Sloan Fellow mathematician, and CTO Shubho Sengupta was formerly Facebook AI Research Director.
key_facts.excerpt: CEO: Carina Hong, 25-year-old Stanford Ph.D. student and MIT graduate. Mathematician Ken Ono (co-founder), Guggenheim/Packard/Sloan Fellow. CTO: Shubho Sengupta, former Facebook AI Research Director.

stories.headline: Microsoft open-sources AgentRx framework for systematically debugging AI agent failures

key_facts.fact: Microsoft Research published AgentRx on March 12, an automated debugging framework that pinpoints the 'critical failure step' in AI agent execution trajectories by synthesizing executable constraints from tool schemas and domain policies.
key_facts.excerpt: AgentRx pinpoints the first unrecoverable ('critical failure') step by synthesizing guarded, executable constraints from tool schemas and domain policies, then logging evidence-backed violations step-by-step.

key_facts.fact: AgentRx improved failure localization accuracy by 23.6% and root-cause attribution by 22.9% compared to prompting baselines across three agent benchmarks.
key_facts.excerpt: Results + release: AgentRx improves failure localization (+23.6%) and root-cause attribution (+22.9%) over prompting baselines.

key_facts.fact: The team released the AgentRx Benchmark with 115 manually annotated failed trajectories across three domains: tau-bench (structured API workflows), Flash (incident management), and Magentic-One (web and file tasks using multi-agent systems).
key_facts.excerpt: Benchmark + taxonomy: We release AgentRx Benchmark with 115 manually annotated failed trajectories across τ-bench, Flash, and Magentic-One, plus a grounded nine-category failure taxonomy.

key_facts.fact: The framework introduces a nine-category failure taxonomy covering issues like 'Plan Adherence Failure,' 'Invention of New Information,' and 'Invalid Invocation,' and the full framework, code, and dataset are open-sourced.
key_facts.excerpt: We release AgentRx Benchmark with 115 manually annotated failed trajectories across τ-bench, Flash, and Magentic-One, plus a grounded nine-category failure taxonomy. The framework and dataset are publicly available.

sources.title: Systematic debugging for AI agents: Introducing the AgentRx framework

stories.headline: Nature Medicine study: AI with cognitive layer outperforms human therapists on CBT in double-blind trial

key_facts.fact: A randomized, double-blind study published in Nature Medicine on March 12 found that LLMs augmented with Limbic's cognitive layer architecture consistently outperformed both standalone state-of-the-art LLMs and human clinicians across key competencies for delivering cognitive-behavioral therapy.
key_facts.excerpt: Randomized, double-blind trial shows Limbic's clinical reasoning layer turns leading LLMs into mental health specialists, achieving gold-standard clinical performance.

key_facts.fact: The trial involved 227 human participants generating naturalistic therapy session transcripts by interacting with different therapy agents, assessed by a consortium of 22 expert clinicians.
key_facts.excerpt: In a randomized, double-blind evaluation, 227 human participants generated naturalistic mental well-being session transcripts by interacting with different therapy agents. A consortium of 22 expert clinicians assessed these transcripts.

key_facts.fact: Results were validated on 19,674 transcripts from a large-scale real-world deployment supporting 8,920 users seeking mental well-being assistance. Increased cognitive layer activation was associated with greater symptom improvement and higher likelihood of long-term clinical recovery at approximately 10 weeks.
key_facts.excerpt: We validated these results in an analysis of 19,674 transcripts from a large-scale, real-world deployment where an LLM embedded within this cognitive layer architecture was used as part of healthcare delivery to support 8,920 users. Increased cognitive layer activation was associated with greater symptom improvement and a higher likelihood of long-term clinical recovery (~10 weeks).

key_facts.fact: Limbic CEO Ross Harper stated: 'Millions of people are already turning to general-purpose AI tools for mental health support, often without clinical validation or safeguards. Our study shows that safe, high-quality AI-enabled therapy is not just possible, but scientifically demonstrable.'
key_facts.excerpt: 'Millions of people are already turning to general-purpose AI tools for mental health support, often without clinical validation or safeguards. Our study shows that safe, high-quality AI-enabled therapy is not just possible, but scientifically demonstrable.'

stories.headline: Databricks launches autonomous coding agent Genie Code and acquires Quotient AI

key_facts.excerpt: Databricks today launched Genie Code, an autonomous AI agent that fundamentally changes how data work gets done. Genie Code can carry out complex tasks such as building pipelines, debugging failures, shipping dashboards, and maintaining production systems.

key_facts.fact: On real-world data science tasks, Genie Code achieved a 77.1% success rate, more than doubling the 32.1% achieved by leading coding agents.
key_facts.excerpt: On real-world data science tasks, Databricks found Genie Code more than doubled the success rate of leading coding agents.

key_facts.fact: Databricks simultaneously acquired Quotient AI, an agent evaluation specialist whose founders previously led quality efforts for GitHub Copilot. Quotient monitors agent performance, catches regressions, and feeds a reinforcement learning loop.
key_facts.excerpt: Databricks acquired Quotient AI to strengthen continuous evaluation. Quotient monitors agent performance, measures answer quality, catches regressions, and feeds a reinforcement learning loop. Quotient's founders previously led quality efforts for GitHub Copilot.

key_facts.fact: CEO Ali Ghodsi stated: 'We are calling this Agentic Data Work. It will fundamentally change how enterprises make decisions,' emphasizing the shift from AI-assisted work to AI-driven work guided by humans.

stories.headline: Google launches Gemini Embedding 2, its first natively multimodal embedding model

key_facts.fact: Google launched Gemini Embedding 2 on March 12, its first natively multimodal embedding model that processes text, images, video, audio, and documents in a single unified system, replacing the need for separate per-modality embedding models.
key_facts.excerpt: Google launched Gemini Embedding 2, described as 'its first natively multimodal embedding model supporting text, images, video, audio, and documents for enterprise use.'

key_facts.fact: The model uses Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL), enabling flexible vector dimension outputs that let developers optimize the tradeoff between performance and cost without retraining.
key_facts.excerpt: The model employs Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL), enabling flexible vector dimension outputs. This approach allows developers to optimize performance and cost based on specific use cases without retraining.

key_facts.fact: Gemini Embedding 2 consolidates text, image, video, and audio processing into one architecture, streamlining enterprise AI workflows that previously required maintaining separate embedding models for different content types.
key_facts.excerpt: Rather than maintaining separate models for different content types, Gemini Embedding 2 consolidates text, image, video, and audio processing into one architecture, streamlining enterprise AI workflows.

stories.headline: Tesla showcases Gen 3 Optimus humanoid robot at AWE 2026 in Shanghai

key_facts.fact: Tesla showcased its upcoming third-generation Optimus humanoid robot at the 2026 Appliance & Electronics World Expo (AWE 2026), which opened March 12 in Shanghai. On-site staff said mass production is scheduled to begin by end of 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Tesla showcased its upcoming third-generation humanoid robot at the 2026 Appliance & Electronics World Expo (AWE 2026), which opened Thursday in Shanghai. This will be the US electric vehicle (EV) maker's first mass-produced version humanoid robot, with production scheduled to start by the end of 2026.

key_facts.fact: Tesla's long-term planned production capacity for Optimus is 1 million units per year, with its Fremont Factory initial line targeting that volume and Gigafactory Texas expected to produce up to 10 million units per year.
key_facts.excerpt: Tesla previously indicated that it plans to manufacture its humanoid robots at scale once production begins, with its initial production line in the Fremont Factory reaching up to 1 million units annually. An Optimus production line at Gigafactory Texas is expected to produce 10 million units per year.

key_facts.fact: The robot demonstrated highly detailed, human-like hands with finger proportions closely resembling those of a human, able to form a heart shape by precisely touching fingers and thumbs together. key_facts.fact: The round values Mind Robotics at $2 billion, making it the largest early-stage investment the robotics industry has ever seen.

stories.headline: Household robot startup Sunday raises $165M Series B at $1.15B unicorn valuation

key_facts.excerpt: Sunday, the company building helpful home robots, announced it has raised an oversubscribed $165 million Series B funding round at a $1.15 billion valuation. The round was led by Coatue, with Thomas Laffont joining the board.

key_facts.fact: Founded by Tony Zhao and Cheng Chi, Sunday is building a humanoid robot called Memo designed for household tasks like clearing dinner tables, doing laundry, and loading dishwashers. The company plans to deploy its first autonomous robots by Thanksgiving 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Sunday moves to focus entirely on real-world deployment of its robot, Memo... deploying autonomous object manipulation in a real-world home environment has never been achieved. Sunday plans to break that cycle with their upcoming Beta taking on time-intensive household chores.

key_facts.fact: Sunday owns the full stack from hardware design and manufacturing to its proprietary Skill Capture Glove for data collection, enabling what it calls the industry's fastest model iteration loop. The team includes 70+ engineers from Stanford, Tesla, DeepMind, Waymo, Meta, OpenAI, and Apple.

key_facts.fact: The company emerged from stealth in late 2025 and already has over 1,000 people on its waitlist. It has tripled its engineering staff and quadrupled its research team.

stories.headline: China ends month-long launch hiatus with double mission: Guowang internet and Shiyan-30 test satellites

key_facts.fact: China resumed orbital launches on March 12 after a month-long hiatus with a Long March 8A lifting off from Hainan at 19:48 UTC, carrying the 20th batch of Guowang LEO internet constellation satellites. CASC announced launch success about two hours later.
key_facts.excerpt: The resumption came on Thursday, with a Long March 8A lifting off from Hainan commercial launch center at 2:48 p.m. Eastern, March 12 (1948 UTC). The China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation (CASC) announced launch success around two hours after liftoff.

key_facts.fact: Less than three hours later, a Long March 2D launched from Xichang at 22:33 UTC on March 12, delivering two Shiyan-30 Earth observation technology test satellites (03 and 04) to low Earth orbit. These were the 631st and 632nd Long March missions.
key_facts.excerpt: A Long March 2D blasted off from Launch Complex 3 at 06:33 am China Standard Time on March 13th (22:33 pm Universal Coordinated Time on March 12th) and flew into low Earth orbit, delivering a pair of satellites.

key_facts.fact: The Guowang constellation now has around 163 operational satellites, with targets of 400 satellites by 2027 and a full constellation of 13,000 satellites. Long March 8A launches typically carry nine Guowang satellites.
key_facts.excerpt: Around 163 operational Guowang satellites currently orbit, with targets of 400 satellites by 2027. The full constellation is designed to include 13,000 satellites.

key_facts.fact: China had not launched since February 12. The extended pause was attributed to the Chinese New Year holiday, annual political sessions in Beijing, and a Long March 3B failure in January.
key_facts.excerpt: The country had not conducted a launch since Feb. 12... ahead of a break for the Chinese New Year holiday. China's annual political sessions in Beijing and a failure of a Long March 3B launch in January may also have contributed to the extended pause.

key_facts.fact: The Shiyan-30 03 and 04 satellites, developed by the Shanghai Academy of Spaceflight Technology, are for experimental verification of Earth observation technologies, following on from the first pair launched in September 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: The test satellites, Shiyan-30 03 and 04, were launched at 6:33 a.m. (Beijing Time) aboard a Long March-2D carrier rocket and entered the preset orbit successfully. The satellites will be mainly used for experimental verification of Earth observation technologies.

stories.headline: UMC and HyperLight partner to mass-produce TFLN photonics chiplets for 1.6T data centers

key_facts.fact: The TFLN platform enables extreme high modulation bandwidth, CMOS-level drive voltage, and ultralow optical loss, reducing laser consumption and supporting CMOS direct-drive for lower power consumption. Applications include short-reach data center pluggables, coherent datacom/telecom modules, and co-packaged optics (CPO).

stories.headline: Iran's new leader Khamenei vows to keep Hormuz closed, warns US bases will be attacked

key_facts.fact: Mojtaba Khamenei issued his first public statement on March 12 since being appointed supreme leader on March 9, vowing to continue blocking the Strait of Hormuz as a 'tool to pressure the enemy.' The statement was read by a state TV broadcaster, not delivered in person.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran's new supreme leader, Mojtaba Khamenei, said Thursday that the closure of the Strait of Hormuz maritime passage should be continued as a 'tool to pressure the enemy,' in his first public statement since being appointed.

key_facts.fact: Khamenei demanded all US military bases in the Middle East close immediately, warning 'those bases will be attacked.'
key_facts.excerpt: Khamenei also said all U.S. military bases in the Middle East should close immediately and 'those bases will be attacked,' in televised comments translated by Reuters.

key_facts.fact: Khamenei failed to appear on camera, with the statement read aloud by a news presenter, raising questions about his health after he was apparently wounded in the same Israeli strike that killed his father on February 28.
key_facts.excerpt: the defiant message has failed to dispel questions over the health of Mojtaba Khamenei after he was apparently wounded in the same Israeli air strike that killed his father, the previous supreme leader, in the opening minutes of the war. Khamenei failed to appear on camera and the statement was read aloud by a news presenter on Iranian state TV.

key_facts.fact: Oil prices extended gains following the statement. Brent crude crossed $100 per barrel, up 50% from a month ago, as most tankers were unwilling to approach the Iranian coastline.
key_facts.excerpt: Brent crude crossed $100 per barrel — up 50% from a month ago — as most oil tankers were unwilling to go anywhere near the Iranian coastline.

key_facts.fact: US Energy Secretary Chris Wright indicated the Hormuz closure could persist for weeks, with the military fix of naval escorts not available until April.
key_facts.excerpt: US officials admitted the crucial shipping lane could remain closed for weeks... with one military fix of naval escorts not available until April.

stories.headline: Iran launches drone attacks on Saudi Arabia and UAE, explosions hit Dubai

key_facts.fact: Iran launched multiple attacks early Friday March 13 on Gulf Arab states, including dozens of drones at Saudi Arabia, following Khamenei's warnings about US bases hosted in the region.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran launched multiple attacks early Friday on Gulf Arab states, including dozens of drones at Saudi Arabia, following warnings from its new supreme leader about hosting American bases.

key_facts.fact: Explosions rattled buildings in Dubai and a large cloud of smoke hung over a central area of the Middle East financial hub on Friday.
key_facts.excerpt: Explosions rattled buildings in Dubai and a large cloud of smoke hung over a central area of the Middle East financial hub on Friday.

key_facts.fact: On March 12, Qatar intercepted multiple missiles and drones, while Saudi Arabia stopped two drones heading toward its Shaybah oil field.
key_facts.excerpt: Qatar intercepted multiple missiles/drones; Saudi Arabia stopped two drones heading toward Shaybah oil field.

key_facts.fact: Two tankers were targeted in an Iraqi port and three commercial ships hit in the Persian Gulf on March 12, as Iran continued to expand strikes on Gulf shipping and infrastructure.
key_facts.excerpt: March 12: Two tankers targeted in Iraqi port; three commercial ships in Persian Gulf hit.

stories.headline: Israel strikes Iran's Parchin nuclear facility and 200+ IRGC targets in 24 hours

key_facts.fact: The IDF struck Iran's Parchin-Taleghan 2 advanced explosives experiments nuclear facility on March 12. The site had previously served as an AMAD-era nuclear weapons group facility.
key_facts.excerpt: The IDF on Thursday said it had struck Iran's advanced explosives experiments nuclear facility at Parchin-Taleghan 2... Parchin-Taleghan 2 had previously served as an AMAD-era nuclear weapons group site relating to nuclear weapons development.

key_facts.fact: The IDF completed 20 waves of strikes across western and central Iran over 24 hours ending March 13, targeting over 200 regime sites including missile launchers, defense systems, and weapons production sites.
key_facts.excerpt: The IDF completed 20 waves of strikes across western and central Iran over the past day, targeting over 200 regime sites, including missile launchers, defense systems, and weapons production sites, the military confirmed on Friday.

key_facts.fact: US Central Command reported having struck approximately 6,000 Iranian targets since the war began on February 28, including 60+ ships and 30 minelayers.
key_facts.excerpt: U.S. Central Command reported striking ~6,000 Iranian targets, including 60+ ships and 30 minelayers.

key_facts.fact: Large explosions shook Tehran on Friday March 13 during an al-Quds Day rally attended by top officials. State media said one woman was killed from shrapnel from a US-Israeli airstrike.
key_facts.excerpt: State media outlet Press TV says one woman was killed from shrapnel as a result of a US-Israeli airstrike.

stories.headline: US issues 30-day sanctions waiver for Russian oil stranded at sea to stabilize markets

key_facts.fact: The US issued a 30-day waiver allowing countries to buy sanctioned Russian oil and petroleum products currently stranded at sea, in a move Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent called a step to stabilize global energy markets roiled by the Iran war.
key_facts.excerpt: The United States issued a 30-day waiver for countries to buy sanctioned Russian oil and petroleum products currently stranded at sea, in what Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said was a step to stabilize global energy markets roiled by the Iran war.

key_facts.fact: Oil prices eased on Friday morning in Asia after the waiver announcement. The move was the latest attempt by the Trump administration to tame energy prices after the Hormuz closure disrupted vital Middle East oil and gas flows.
key_facts.excerpt: Oil prices eased on Friday morning in Asia after the U.S. waiver announcement. The move was the latest attempt by President Donald Trump's administration to tame energy prices after the U.S. and Israeli strikes on Iran and the subsequent response by Tehran widened regional tensions and paralyzed shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

key_facts.fact: On Wednesday March 12, Washington separately announced the release of 172 million barrels of oil from the US Strategic Petroleum Reserve to help curb surging oil prices.
key_facts.excerpt: On Wednesday, Washington announced it would be releasing 172 million barrels of oil from the strategic petroleum reserve in an effort to curb sky-rocketing oil prices.

key_facts.fact: The sanctions on Russian oil companies Lukoil and Rosneft were originally imposed by Trump last November. The waiver authorizes only oil already stranded at sea, designed to limit financial benefit to Russia.
key_facts.excerpt: This deliberately short-term measure will not provide significant financial benefit to the Russian government as it only authorizes transactions involving oil already stranded at sea.

stories.headline: Zelensky meets Macron in Paris to discuss stalled EU loan and Russian shadow fleet

key_facts.fact: Ukrainian President Zelensky arrived in Paris on Friday March 13 for talks with Macron on increasing pressure on Russia, as US-brokered peace talks between Russia and Ukraine have stalled due to the Iran war.
key_facts.excerpt: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky arrived in Paris on Friday, his spokesman said, for talks with President Emmanuel Macron on ways to increase pressure on Russia... The visit comes as talks brokered by the United States to end the four-year invasion have been derailed by the US-Israeli war with Iran.

key_facts.fact: Key topics include unblocking the EU's 90 billion euro credit for Ukraine, approved by EU leaders in December 2025 but stalled since February after Hungary blocked its release over a dispute about Russian oil transit through the Druzhba pipeline.
key_facts.excerpt: unblocking the EU's 90 billion credit for Ukraine will be among the key topics of the visit. The loan, approved by EU leaders in December 2025, has been stalled since February after Hungary blocked its release, citing a dispute over Russian oil transit through the Druzhba pipeline.

key_facts.fact: The talks also focus on increasing sanctions pressure on Russia by targeting its 'shadow fleet' of tankers used to transport oil in breach of sanctions imposed over the 2022 invasion.
key_facts.excerpt: The talks between Macron and Zelensky will focus on increasing sanctions pressure on Russia by targeting its 'shadow fleet.'

key_facts.fact: A US delegation had met with lead Russian negotiator Kirill Dmitriev in Miami on March 11, but those talks produced no concrete outcomes, with the Kremlin earlier indicating the 2022 Istanbul proposals 'no longer correspond to the changed situation.'
key_facts.excerpt: US Special Envoy to the Middle East Steve Witkoff reported on March 11 that he, former Senior Advisor to the US President Jared Kushner, and senior advisor to US President Donald Trump's Board of Peace Josh Gruenbaum met with Dmitriev in Miami. Witkoff stated that the teams discussed 'a variety of topics' and agreed to continue contacts, but did not offer further details.

stories.headline: Pakistan launches airstrikes on Kabul, Kandahar and Khost in Afghanistan

key_facts.fact: Pakistan Air Force carried out three separate airstrikes within one hour in Kabul, with residents confirming the strikes. PAF jets also targeted areas in Kandahar and Khost province, aimed at militant hideouts within Afghan territory.
key_facts.excerpt: the Pakistan Air Force (PAF) carried out multiple airstrikes in the Afghan capital... the PAF conducted three separate attacks within the span of just one hour in the city. Pakistani jets have also targeted several other areas, including Kandahar and Khost province.

key_facts.fact: Pakistan bombed the fuel depot belonging to private airline Kam Air near Kandahar Airport. Taliban spokesperson Zabihullah Mujahid said the facility also provides fuel for UN aircraft.
key_facts.excerpt: Pakistan Air Forces have struck the fuel depots belonging to the private airline Kam Air near Kandahar Airport, Taliban spokesperson Zabihullah Mujahid said on Friday... this company provides fuel materials for domestic airlines as well as for United Nations aircraft.

key_facts.fact: Four members of one family were killed and three injured from Pakistani artillery shelling in the Alisher-Terezai district of Khost province, near the Durand Line.
key_facts.excerpt: Pakistan's military also targeted various areas of the Alisher-Terezai district of Khost province, near the Hypothetical Durand Line, with artillery fire. Four members of one family were killed, and three others were injured as a result of the shelling.

key_facts.fact: India rejected Pakistan's allegations that India was aggravating the skirmishes with Afghanistan, calling the claims 'baseless' and accusing Pakistan of blaming others for its own failures.
key_facts.excerpt: India on Thursday rejected Pakistan's allegations of aggravating skirmishes with Afghanistan, calling them 'baseless' and accusing Pakistan of blaming others for its own misdeeds.

stories.headline: S&P 500 drops 1.5% as Wall Street braces for prolonged Iran war; Exxon hits all-time high

key_facts.fact: The S&P 500 closed down 1.52% on March 12, with US stocks down for the year excluding oil producers. Asian and European markets also fell, with India's Nifty 50 off more than 2% and South Korea's KOSPI losing 1.72%.
key_facts.excerpt: S&P 500: Closed down 1.52% yesterday... India's Nifty 50: Off more than 2%... South Korean KOSPI: Lost 1.72%.

key_facts.fact: Trump stated the US has 'unparalleled firepower, unlimited ammunition, and plenty of time,' with analysts focusing on the final three words as signaling a prolonged conflict. Ed Yardeni noted markets may be 'discounting the possibility that the war won't be short.'
key_facts.excerpt: The President stated: 'We have unparalleled firepower, unlimited ammunition, and plenty of time,' with analysts focusing on those final three words as indicating a prolonged conflict... Ed Yardeni noted the market may be 'discounting the possibility that the war won't be short.'

key_facts.fact: Exxon and Chevron hit all-time highs. Oil exceeded $100 per barrel again, with 18 vessels struck in the Strait of Hormuz so far and the US Navy unable to secure safe passage for tankers.

stories.headline: Adobe CEO Shantanu Narayen steps down after 18 years amid investor AI concerns

key_facts.fact: Adobe CEO Shantanu Narayen announced on March 12 that he will resign after 18 years in the role, staying on until a successor is found and then remaining as chair of the board.
key_facts.excerpt: The CEO of creative software giant Adobe, Shantanu Narayen, is to resign after 18 years in the role, with lead independent director Frank Calderoni tasked with running the process of finding a replacement. Narayen will stay in position until the recruitment of his successor is completed, and is to remain on as chair of the Adobe board.

key_facts.fact: Adobe shares dropped over 7% in after-hours trading on the announcement. The stock is down significantly as the company grapples with a changing software landscape where AI is lowering barriers to entry for design.
key_facts.excerpt: Adobe stock fell more than 7% on the news.

key_facts.fact: Narayen joined Adobe in 1988 and became CEO in 2007, overseeing the shift from software licenses to subscriptions. Under his tenure, Adobe grew from 3,000 employees to over 30,000 and from less than $1B to more than $25B in revenue. He earned $51M in fiscal 2025 and owns $118M in Adobe stock.
key_facts.excerpt: in his 28 years with the company, it had grown from having around 3,000 employees to more than 30,000, and from revenues of less than $1bn to more than $25bn.

key_facts.fact: The departure comes amid deep skepticism about Adobe's ability to thrive in the AI era, with the company doubling down on AI partnerships and exploring acquisitions to maintain its lead in creative software.
key_facts.excerpt: Adobe is searching for a new chief executive after CEO Shantanu Narayen said Thursday that he plans to step down after 18 years in the role.

stories.headline: Celularity secures $35M licensing deal to focus on aging biology therapies

key_facts.fact: Regenerative medicine company Celularity signed a $35 million strategic licensing partnership, bringing fresh capital while narrowing the company's focus on therapies targeting the biology of aging.
key_facts.excerpt: Strategic licensing partnership brings fresh capital while narrowing the company's focus on therapies targeting the biology of aging.

key_facts.fact: The deal represents a significant pivot for Celularity, a company known for its work with placenta-derived cell therapies, as it concentrates resources specifically on longevity and aging-related treatments.
key_facts.excerpt: A $35 million deal may not sound unusual in biotech, but for regenerative medicine company Celularity, the licensing agreement marks a meaningful shift.

key_facts.fact: The deal comes as the longevity sector gains visibility, with the World Financial Review publishing its first official power rankings of 11 longevity startups on March 11, framing the space as part of the broader health innovation market.
key_facts.excerpt: Published on March 11, 2026, the outlet's official power rankings of 11 leading longevity startups present the space as an increasingly visible and organized part of the broader health innovation market.
